description: Header file defining the QuicCryptoClientHandshaker class, which implements the handshake protocol for QUIC crypto within the Chromium project. It declares methods, members, and nested classes related to QUIC cryptographic handshake management.

classes.name: QuicCryptoClientHandshaker
classes.description: Implements the QUIC crypto handshake protocol as a handshaker interface, managing handshake states, proof verification, and encryption setup.

classes.name: ProofVerifierCallbackImpl
classes.description: Nested class implementing callback for proof verification results, used asynchronously during handshake.

methods.name: CryptoConnect
methods.description: Initiates the cryptographic handshake process.

methods.name: num_sent_client_hellos
methods.description: Returns the number of ClientHello messages sent.

methods.name: IsResumption
methods.description: Checks if the handshake is a session resumption.

methods.name: EarlyDataAccepted
methods.description: Indicates if early data was accepted.

methods.name: EarlyDataReason
methods.description: Provides the reason for early data acceptance or rejection.

methods.name: ReceivedInchoateReject
methods.description: Checks if an inchoate reject was received.

methods.name: num_scup_messages_received
methods.description: Returns the number of SCUP messages received.

methods.name: chlo_hash
methods.description: Returns the hash of the last ClientHello message.

methods.name: encryption_established
methods.description: Checks if encryption has been established.

methods.name: IsCryptoFrameExpectedForEncryptionLevel
methods.description: Determines if a crypto frame is expected at a given encryption level.

methods.name: GetEncryptionLevelToSendCryptoDataOfSpace
methods.description: Gets the encryption level for sending crypto data in a specific packet number space.

methods.name: one_rtt_keys_available
methods.description: Checks if 1-RTT keys are available.

methods.name: crypto_negotiated_params
methods.description: Returns negotiated cryptographic parameters.

methods.name: crypto_message_parser
methods.description: Provides access to the crypto message parser.

methods.name: GetHandshakeState
methods.description: Returns the current handshake state.

methods.name: BufferSizeLimitForLevel
methods.description: Returns buffer size limit for a given encryption level.

methods.name: AdvanceKeysAndCreateCurrentOneRttDecrypter
methods.description: Advances cryptographic keys and creates a decrypter for 1-RTT.

methods.name: CreateCurrentOneRttEncrypter
methods.description: Creates an encrypter for 1-RTT.

methods.name: OnHandshakePacketSent
methods.description: Callback when a handshake packet is sent.

methods.name: OnConnectionClosed
methods.description: Handles connection closure.

methods.name: OnHandshakeDoneReceived
methods.description: Handles receipt of handshake completion message.

methods.name: OnNewTokenReceived
methods.description: Handles receipt of a new token.

methods.name: OnHandshakeMessage
methods.description: Processes an incoming handshake message.
